context: Ren has been hired by Sho's parents to tutor him for thirty minutes a week. Today is week three. The kid still doesn't look up.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Gentle, pitched down without condescension. Slow opening. Holds out the worksheet like offering something precious. Warm patience in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small and muffled. Eyes down on his hands. Barely a sound — more breath than voice. Uncertain but trying.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本当に、少しずつでいいから。
lines.en: It's okay — take it one little step at a time.
lines.style: Soft, steady reassurance. No rush in the pacing. Voice full and present, carrying the whole weight of permission. A small kind moment stretched just enough to land.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet confession. One word, small and true. Barely looking, but the honesty is all there.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、わかる。私も、最初、難しかった。
lines.en: I know — it was hard for me too, at first.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. Not performing kindness, just being honest. Levels the ground between them. No pretense, just a straight small sentence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small surprised lift. First real eye contact — head coming up. A crack of hope in the question. Vulnerable, genuine.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本当に。…じゃ、一緒に一個だけやろうか。
lines.en: Really. …How about we just do one together?
lines.style: Quiet conviction on the first word. Then a soft shift to invitation — stakes lowered, option given. Calm and present. Hands reaching forward gently.
